weapon.d: Accelerates Special trigger (cooldown count-1). At start of combat, if Special is ready, grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+5 during combat and foe cannot make a follow-up attack.

special.d: Boosts damage by 50% of unit's Def.
Boosts damage by 50% of unit's Def.
Boosts damage by 50% of unit's Def. Restores HP = 25% of damage dealt.

a.d: Unit can counterattack regardless of foe's range.

b.d: If unit initiates combat and unit's Special triggers before or during combat, grants Special cooldown count-1 after combat.
If Special triggers before or during combat, grants Special cooldown count-1 after combat.
If Special triggers before or during combat, grants Special cooldown count-2 after combat.

c.d: At start of turn, if unit is adjacent to an ally, grants Def/Res+3 to unit for 1 turn.
At start of turn, if unit is adjacent to an ally, grants Def/Res+4 to unit for 1 turn.
At start of turn, if unit is adjacent to an ally, grants Def/Res+5 to unit for 1 turn.
